% REQ: LANG-381 LANG-382 LANG-383 LANG-384 LANG-385
%{
Block comment
over lines
%}
function result = greet(name, times)
    % Greets name times times.
    if nargin < 2
        times = 1;
    end
    text = sprintf('Hello, %s!\n', name);
    quoted = 'it''s';
    s = "double ""quoted""";
    A = [1 2; 3 4];
    B = A' * A.';
    C = A(1, :)';
    result = repmat(text, 1, times);
    for k = 1:numel(A)
        if A(k) > 2 && ~isempty(B)
            disp(k);
        elseif k == 0
            continue
        end
    end
    x = 0x1F + 1.5e3 + pi;
end
